title: First TBM Delivered for Yonge North Subway Extension
summary:
Last month marked a major milestone in the construction of the Yonge Line 1 North Subway Extension (YNSE). On October 26, Metrolinx announced the arrival of the first of two tunnel boring machines (TBMs) that will excavate twin 6.3-kilometre subway tunnels between the launch site near Highway 407 and Finch Station following their assembly.

The announcement follows the completion of the tunnel launch shaft in July, located just south of Langstaff GO Station, east of Yonge Street. With nearly 70,000 cubic metres of soil removed to construct it, the shaft will serve as the launch point for TBMs, which, once lowered underground and assembled piece by piece, will begin their southward tunnelling in the direction of Finch Station.
